title: Iron Mist/Skill history

{{Skill history}}

== [[Feedback:Game updates/20120913|September 13, 2012 ]] ==
*Changed type to enchantment spell; reduced casting time to 1 second; reduced recharge to 20 seconds; changed functionality to: "For 8...15 seconds, you have +15 armor. Your Air Magic spells that target a foe activate and recharge 25% faster, but you are Overcast by 3 points."

== Pre-release ==
During early development, this skill made the target unable to move, instead of slowing them by 90%, and caused Exhaustion (Overcast) as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine Issue #5<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue05.pdf</ref>.
